plan.notes: Source: Allegany College of Maryland Credit Catalog 2026-2027, Nanotechnology (Area of Concentration) program path (official 2026-2027 catalog TOC, https://catalog.allegany.edu/current/_pdf-props.pdf). 'Successful completion of this program qualifies a student to apply for an Associate of Science degree in Arts and Sciences - Area of Concentration in Nanotechnology from Allegany College of Maryland upon completion of the coursework at PSU.' The program is offered in partnership with The Pennsylvania State University (PSU); the fourth semester is the PSU capstone semester in Nanotechnology at University Park, PA. Caveats: (1) Footnote 1: 'Psychology 101 and Speech 101 are preferred to other electives.' (2) Footnote 2: 'Social and Behavioral Science elective must be from two different disciplines.' (3) Footnote 3: 'Arts and Humanities elective must be from two different disciplines.' (4) Footnote **: 'Students who have the math background and plan to continue for their education towards a Bachelor's degree in Nanotechnology or Engineering must take Calculus I (Mathematics 201), General Physics I (Physics 201) and General Physics II (Physics 202).' (5) Footnote ***: 'A transfer agreement exists between ACM and PSU. Students need to apply to PSU and be accepted in order to attend the capstone semester.' (6) Math placement: students who need Mathematics 119 can finish in 4 semesters by starting in the Spring semester and enrolling in the PSU capstone the following summer. (7) Capstone course codes are transcribed verbatim as the catalog renders them ('NANO0211', etc.); titles transcribed verbatim including 'Basis Nanotechnology Processes' as printed. Hand-transcribed 2026-10-01.
